import json,urllib.request,collections
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8091/api/runs',timeout=60))
for k in ('me','bot','both'):
    a=d['accounts'][k]['account']
    print(k,{x:a[x] for x in a if x not in ('log','open','curve')})
a=d['accounts']['bot']['account']
log=a['log']
print('log n',len(log),'keys',sorted(log[0].keys()))
def grp(keyf,name):
    g=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0,0.0,0.0])
    for t in log:
        if t.get('open'): continue
        k=keyf(t); g[k][0]+=1; g[k][1]+=1 if t['pnl']>0 else 0; g[k][2]+=t['pnl']; g[k][3]+=t['net']
    print('==',name)
    for k,v in sorted(g.items(),key=lambda kv:kv[1][2]):
        print(k,'n',v[0],'wins',v[1],'pnl',round(v[2],3),'avgnet',round(v[3]/v[0],2))
grp(lambda t:t['side'],'side')
grp(lambda t:t['tf'],'tf')
grp(lambda t:(t['side'],t.get('sig')),'side+sig')
grp(lambda t:t.get('be'),'be')
rs={}
for r in d['runs']:
    for x in r['trades']: rs[(r['id'],x['t_in'])]=x['reason']
grp(lambda t:t['sym'],'sym')
tot_fee=sum(abs(t['notional'])*0.001 for t in log if not t.get('open'))
print('fees_est',round(tot_fee,3),'gross_pnl_est',round(sum(t['pnl'] for t in log if not t.get('open'))+tot_fee,3))
# reasons from runs of bot track
g=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0,0.0])
for r in d['runs']:
    if r.get('track')!='bot': continue
    for x in r['trades']:
        if x['open']: continue
        g[x['reason']][0]+=1; g[x['reason']][1]+=1 if x['net']>0 else 0; g[x['reason']][2]+=x['net']
print('== reasons (all bot runs, net% sum)')
for k,v in sorted(g.items(),key=lambda kv:kv[1][2]): print(k,v[0],'wins',v[1],'net_sum',round(v[2],1))
print('runs bot',sum(1 for r in d['runs'] if r.get('track')=='bot'),'me',sum(1 for r in d['runs'] if r.get('track')=='me'))
